resolved_findings.title: Composition overwrote an active explicit-target fade palette through PAL_GetPalette shared static storage
resolved_findings.original_path: VIDEO_DisplaySurface -> PAL_GetPalette(gpGlobals palette) during PAL_FadeIn using a pointer returned by PAL_GetPalette(explicit palette)
resolved_findings.concrete_callsite: ending.c:435 calls PAL_FadeIn(5, FALSE, 1); its explicit target need not equal gpGlobals->wNumPalette.
resolved_findings.current_fix: palette.c:25-95 adds PAL_ReadPalette caller-owned output and retains the PAL_GetPalette static wrapper. video.c:202-214 and tests/render_evidence.cpp:27-30 use local output arrays.
resolved_findings.status: Resolved by static inspection of current implementation.
resolved_findings.regression_fixture: tests/render_evidence.cpp:242-256 executes the actual timed PAL_FadeIn(5,FALSE,1) and compares all 256 resulting RGB entries; reviewer inspected it but did not execute it.

findings.title: Night dialogue is checked against its own palette/background rather than an independent night oracle
findings.evidence: Only not-night images are compared with R1 indices/palette at 162-171. The fallback image, nearest-color mapping and visible mask at 160-193 are all derived from the new night output itself.
findings.failure: A broken -night-rgb mode that emits the otherwise correct daytime images can satisfy the same RGB and scaling comparisons and be exported with night labels. Changes to night-only text/background are also accepted if composed RGB agrees with the changed indexed source.
findings.proof_method: Static counterexample; no fixture mutation or test execution performed.
findings.minimum_fix: Validate expected night PAT palette from fixed original resource bytes; derive expected night indices from a trusted existing frame and source portrait mapping, preserving all nonportrait pixels with only the established complete selected-glyph phase exception. Avoid using the candidate night image as its own oracle.
findings.fix_evidence: verify_portrait_colors.py:49-76 remaps a trusted daytime image, retaining nonportrait pixels and allowing only the complete selected-glyph uniform phase exception. Lines 98-103 require PAT membership in fingerprinted originals and decode chunk 0 night colors; 205-222 bind the R1 source BMP hash and require exact night palette and independent index expectation.

findings.status: Resolved by static inspection; exporter execution not performed by reviewer
findings.title: Preview crop metadata is not bound to its verified digest
findings.evidence: The exporter verifies BMP hashes and the portrait-pack hash, but reads win-adapted/portraits.csv directly to select dimensions and x/y without checking the metadata_sha256 already in versions.win.checks.
findings.failure: A stale or edited CSV can crop the unchanged, verified BMPs at the wrong region while still publishing Face/night/day labels and a fitted Saturn reference.
findings.minimum_fix: Require adapted metadata hash to match the verified report before reading rows, and require the selected rows face/palette/night/location/stage/initial_black fields and pack dimensions to match the requested view.
findings.fix_evidence: export_portrait_color_previews.py:39-55 checks the adapted metadata SHA, selected face/palette/night/location/stage, and fitted-pack dimensions; lines 74-76 require the independent night palette/index checks before exporting dialogue views. Existing image and pack hash checks remain.

additional_integrity_gap.detail: The expected dialogue BMP and CSV names are taken from current R1 directory glob results. R1 image paths are already recorded in old_report.image_sha256 and should define the trusted full set. CSVs are compared only against current R1 files, which are not individually hashed in that R1 report.
additional_integrity_gap.suggested_hardening: Derive full BMP names from old_report keys; reject missing or extra R1/new images. Bind CSV content to available prior #6 evidence or fixed source fixtures, and record CSV hashes in R2 for subsequent --check-existing/export checks.
additional_integrity_gap.status: Trusted BMP-set gap resolved; CSV history limitation explicitly retained
additional_integrity_gap.fix_evidence: verify_portrait_colors.py:188-194 derives expected R1 BMP names from old_report.image_sha256, rejects current-directory set differences and enforces the exact new output set. Lines 261,267-268 record current CSV hashes and require them on future check-existing runs.
additional_integrity_gap.remaining_boundary: The older R1 report does not contain hashes for every historical dialogue CSV. The first strengthened report still compares those files against the existing R1 copies; recording a hash now protects future changes and does not retroactively prove their earlier provenance. Independently hash-bound R1 image/metadata comparisons protect the published pixel evidence.
